name: nodalia-design
description: Nodalia Design Language: tokens, adapters, components and catalog.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nodalia/tokens && npm run build -w @nodalia/gtk -w @nodalia/qml -w @nodalia/egui -w @nodalia/qtwidgets -w @nodalia/web -w @nodalia/catalog
scripts.validate: npm run validate -w @nodalia/tokens && npm run lint -w @nodalia/web
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path packages/egui/crate/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path packages/egui/crate/Cargo.toml --features egui
scripts.ci: npm run validate && npm test && npm run check:repro && npm run test:browser
